blocks.text: Pani zindagi ki bunyaad hai. Pani peene (hydration) aur safai (hygiene) se insan zinda aur sehatmand rehte hain, aur pani jism se zehreele (toxic) maddey bahar nikalta hai. Paude pani ki madad se photosynthesis karte hain, aur pani se fasal (crop) ugti hai, is liye zaraat (agriculture) pani par chalti hai. Janwar apne jism ke kaam theek rakhne ke liye pani par depend karte hain, aur be-shumar microorganisms (khurdbeeni jandaar) bhi pani ke baghair zinda nahi reh sakte. Insani taraqqi, zaraat aur khurak ki hifazat (food security) sab pani ki mustaqil (steady) supply par tiki hain.

Qudrat mein pani zameen ki shakal banata hai, mausam (climate) ko balance mein rakhta hai aur zameen ke neeche ke zakhire (underground reservoirs) dobara bharta hai. Darya, jheelein, wetlands (daldali ilaqe) aur samandar jaise ecosystems paudon aur janwaron ki mukhtalif zindagi ke liye pani par depend karte hain. Bijli (energy) banane, transport, shehron ki taraqqi aur science ki research ke liye bhi pani zaroori hai. Pani ki kami (water scarcity) mahol, logon aur maeeshat (economy) sab ke liye khatra hai.

blocks.prompt: Teen wajoohat batayein ke pani zindagi ke liye kyun zaroori hai.
blocks.explanation: In mein se koi teen: insan ko hydration aur safai ke liye pani chahiye aur pani zehreele maddey jism se nikalta hai; paude photosynthesis ke liye pani use karte hain; fasal aur food security pani par depend karti hai; janwar jism ke kaam theek rakhne ke liye pani par depend karte hain; ecosystems (darya, jheelein, samandar) pani par chalte hain.

items: Pani insan, paudon, janwaron aur microorganisms sab ke liye zaroori hai.
Pani mausam ko balance karta aur zameen ke neeche ka pani dobara bharta hai.
Pani ki kami (water scarcity) mahol, logon aur maeeshat ke liye khatra hai.
